name: Abby Hatcher
description: Abby Hatcher is part girl, part superhero; living in a world full of fuzzlies. When a fuzzly friend needs help, Abby takes action – going on a mission to make things right.

videos.title: Afraid of Cats
videos.overview: Melvin gets a new kitten, but the Fuzzlies are afraid of cats.

videos.title: Chef Curly
videos.overview: Curly really wants to help Chef Jeff make an important dinner for the hotel!

videos.title: When Abby Met Bozzly
videos.overview: Abby meets her best Fuzzly friend Bozzly for the first time.

videos.title: Hair Flair Everywhere
videos.overview: When the hotel's salon owner Mrs. Melvin closes the salon for the day, Abby tries to help Harriet, a hair-obsessed Fuzzly, find a new hobby.

videos.title: Mo and Bo, in the Snow
videos.overview: Mo and Bo are mistaken for a snow monster.

videos.title: Otis Out Of Order
videos.overview: When Otis takes a spill, Abby has to help him overcome a sudden fear of heights.

videos.title: There's Only One Bozzly
videos.overview: When Bozzly gets hurt, Melvin steps in as Abby's sidekick.

videos.title: Cousin Flugtilda
videos.overview: Princess Flug's cousin visits the hotel.

videos.title: The Fuzzlies Talent Show
videos.overview: Teeny Terry thinks he doesn't have a talent, so Abby helps him find one for the big Hotel Talent Show.

videos.title: Princess Flug's Flower Float
videos.overview: Abby follows a trail of missing roses to a new Fuzzly: the flower-loving Princess Flug.

videos.title: Too Tired to Tuba
videos.overview: Chef Jeff's nighttime tuba practice keeps all the Fuzzlies awake.

videos.title: Princess Flug Day
videos.overview: Princess Flug thinks Melvin's surprise party is for her, and she gets very upset when she realizes it's not.

videos.title: Hair Flair Fuzzly
videos.overview: When Mrs. Melvin's hairbrush goes missing, Abby tracks it to a new Fuzzly who loves to style hair.

videos.title: The Fuzzlies in the Attic
videos.overview: When the Fuzzly twins, Mo and Bo, get separated in the hotel, it's up to Abby to get them back together again.

videos.title: Curly and the Sock Doll
videos.overview: Otis gets mistaken for a real dog in 'Trick or Treat Otis', then in 'Bedtime for Peepers', when Lex and Miranda have a party, Abby volunteers to put the playful Peepers to bed.

videos.title: In the Park
videos.overview: The Fuzzlies are scared when they think there's a monster lurking in 'Fuzzly Slumber Party', then in 'Fix It Flug', Princess Flug helps Lex and Teeny Terry with her glitter goo.

videos.title: Teeny Terry's Gift
videos.overview: Otis gives Teeny Terry a Gift that The Whole Hotel wants.

videos.title: Peeper Time Blues
videos.overview: The Sqeaky Peepers refuse to sing, and Abby tries to figure out why.

videos.title: Abby's Squeaky Pepper Panic
videos.overview: Little Do, The Youngest of the Squeaky Peepers goes missing, which causes The Rest of the Peepers to have a panic around the hotel.

videos.title: Things That Go Ding in the Night
videos.overview: Otis Sleep Pushes Buttons on the Middle of the Night, which causes Princess Flug to get no sleep, so Abby must put Princess Flug back to bed while Bozzly deals with Otis.

videos.title: Teeny Terry's Treehouse
videos.overview: Teeny Terry wants a special hideaway of his own, just like all the other Fuzzlies.

videos.title: Hearts and Hugs Day
videos.overview: Otis wants to find a special way to show his love on Hearts and Hugs Day.

videos.title: Secret Basement Disco
videos.overview: Abby and Bozzly want to help Harriet overcome her shyness about her favorite activity.

videos.title: Frazzled Fuzzly
videos.overview: Teeny Terry worries that he's too tiny to be helpful.

videos.title: Fuzzly Slumber Party
videos.overview: The Fuzzlies are scared when they think there's a monster lurking around the hotel.

videos.title: Fix It Flug
videos.overview: Princess Flug successfully helps Lex and Teeny Terry with her glitter goo, then goes overboard and \"fixes\" everything in the hotel.

videos.title: Princess Flug's Flowery Adventure
videos.overview: Princess Flug enters and naps in a sleeping bag which Miranda thought it to be empty and sends it to be washed at a laundry shop.

videos.title: Fuzzliest Dinner
videos.overview: Abby, Bozzly, and Curly need to make food for the hotel guests as Chef Jeff is out of the kitchen to help his mother.

videos.title: Princess Flug's Pet Slug
videos.overview: Princess Flug finds a slug in the hotel garden, and wants to make it her pet.

videos.title: Fuzzly Photo Day
videos.overview: Abby wants to get a photograph of her and the Fuzzlies to send to her grandmother.

videos.title: Fairy Tale Fuzzly
videos.overview: Harriet accidentally locks herself in the hotel's tower room while looking for play outfits.

videos.title: Super Secret Passageway
videos.overview: While looking for a place to hide in a game of hide-and-seek, Otis falls into an unknown room in the hotel.

videos.title: Teeny Pelican Terry
videos.overview: Teeny Terry disguises himself as a bird to meet a Pelican family.

videos.title: Tappin Mo and Bo
videos.overview: After finding numerous tap shoes, Mo and Bo put on some before they do some dancing, but their moves are loud and start to jolt the hotel.

videos.title: Grumbles' First Haircut
videos.overview: Grumbles' hair is quite thick and needs some trimming, but he is afraid to have the treatment.

videos.title: Fuzzly Ball
videos.overview: Because Abby's parents can't come to a ball as they need to attend to hotel guests, Abby and the Fuzzlies decide to put up one at the hotel.

videos.title: The Fuzzlies' Camping Trip
videos.overview: Abby's family go on a trip to the great outdoors where a large bizarre creature is rumored to be lurking.

videos.title: Snug Loving Chipmunks
videos.overview: Chipmunks take away Teeny Terry's tree house as they think it is food.

videos.title: Abby's Snug
videos.overview: Melvin takes part in Abby's bedroom because his place is under remodeling, but his snore makes Abby look elsewhere to sleep.

videos.title: Trick or Treat Otis
videos.overview: When Abby and the Fuzzlies are collecting sweets in the suburbs, Otis gets separated from them.

videos.title: Bedtime for Peepers
videos.overview: After the Peepers caused some trouble in the preparation of a late night party, Abby and Bozzly try to put them to bed.

videos.title: Otis on the Go
videos.overview: Otis rides away on Abby's tricycle which is now engine-powered, but it's too fast, and he wants to get off.

videos.title: Abby's Afraid
videos.overview: A dentist visits the hotel to check the teeth of its residents, but Abby is scared and tries to avoid the check up.

videos.title: Shape of Grumbles
videos.overview: After eating a lot of food, Grumbles starts hiccuping which causes him to morph uncontrollably.

videos.title: Wai Po's Wild Day
videos.overview: Abby and the Fuzzlies get into various antics with Abby's grandmother outside the hotel.

videos.title: Abby Loses Elvin
videos.overview: Abby and Bozzly take Elvin to play with them as Melvin is busy building a castle as a surprise gift.

videos.title: The Berry Thief
videos.overview: Abby, Bozzly, and Princess Flug like blueberries as they grow blueberry plants in the hotel garden, but someone starts taking the plants.

videos.title: Here an Abby, There an Abby
The Peeper Transport Tubes
videos.overview: The Peepers deliver stuff around the hotel through a series of tubes. It goes well until they mix up their deliveries and get jammed at the intersection.

videos.title: Abby Loses Her Glasses
videos.overview: Abby's glasses get knocked off her face by a ball, and get carried away by a series of animals. She struggles to see as a result.

videos.title: Game Time with Mo and Bo
videos.overview: Mo and Bo are heavily focused on video snakes and ladders on a tablet, thus they cause some trouble when they play and walk simultaneously.

videos.title: Grumbles Goes Down the Drain
videos.overview: Grumbles bathes in Abby's bath tub but suddenly thins, and get pulled into the drain where he travels through pipes across the hotel.

videos.title: Teeny Terry is... Teeny Man!
videos.overview: Teeny Terry wants to be a hero but he lacks confidence. Thus Abby decides to secretly help him by doing heroic acts but making him think he does them.

videos.title: Mo and Bo and the Missing Button Trail
videos.overview: Abby and some of her Fuzzly pals have a walk in the woods, and drop buttons to mark their path. But they get lost when the buttons get covered in snow.

videos.title: Mo and Bo on a Roll
videos.overview: Mo and Bo put on roller skates, but their being new to the equipment causes them to roll away for miles.

videos.title: Dance Dance Grumbles
videos.overview: Abby and Bozzly try to teach Grumbles how to dance.

videos.title: Super Strength Curly
videos.overview: Princess Flug accidentally shoots a sticky paste into a jelly mix which would give super strength to whoever eats it.

videos.title: Super Sitter Abby
videos.overview: Grumbles has an infant cousin who would multiply when babysat incorrectly.

videos.title: Otis and the Snack Machine
videos.overview: The hotel comes up with a snack dispenser which impresses everybody, except Chef Jeff as no one is interested in his creations.

videos.title: Abby's Runaway Care Case
videos.overview: To give Abby and Bozzly a break from helping a lot of Fuzzlies, Teeny Terry turns Abby's equipment bag into a robot which will do her work.

videos.title: Little Doh's Lost Binky
videos.overview: The pacifier of one of the Peepers gets missing, and Abby and Bozzly must find it.

videos.title: Chef Beth
videos.overview: Chef Jeff's mother comes to visit the hotel and he's determined to make it perfect, but all she really wants is to spend time with her son.

videos.title: Teeny Terry's Perfect Sport
videos.overview: Abby and Bozzly have to find a sport for Teeny Terry without getting him into trouble because of his small size.

videos.title: Abby's Track and Field Day
videos.overview: Abby ponders which track and field event she should participate in as she cannot use her special equipment.

videos.title: Abby and the Costume Ball
videos.overview: When the hotel puts up a costume party, Abby tries to find the perfect costume to wear.

videos.title: Big Terry: Fix-It Fuzzly
videos.overview: Teeny Terry feels unwanted when Lex is seemingly more interested in fixing things with Grumbles.

videos.title: Otis' Sick Day
videos.overview: Otis bruises his tentacles in an elevator mishap, thus other Fuzzlies try to substitute him as elevator operator.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Fuzzlies
videos.overview: Judge Thorn is having the hotel videotaped for her TV show, and Abby's family try to impress her.

videos.title: Fuzzly Beach Day
videos.overview: Otis is afraid to go into the sea, thus he'll try to keep himself and his friends at shore.

videos.title: A Princess and the Peepers
videos.overview: Abby and Bozzly have to get Princess Flug to sleep, otherwise she'll redden and flood the hotel with bubbles that would wash everything away.

videos.title: The Perfect Job for Mo and Bo
videos.overview: Mo and Bo want to have regular work in the hotel just like the other Fuzzlies.

videos.title: Teeny Terry: Safety Officer
videos.overview: Lex and Teeny Terry install an emergency sound system that would inform everyone at the hotel of an emergency.

videos.title: Abby Babysits Melvin
videos.overview: Melvin's parents go out together overnight, thus they leave Melvin at the hotel to be taken care of by Abby and the Fuzzlies.

videos.title: Princess Flug Goes Skiing
videos.overview: Princess Flug joins Abby, Bozzly, and Otis on a ski trip even though she is inadept with the sport as she refuses to miss some fun.

videos.title: Mo & Bo's Big Art Show
videos.overview: Mo and Bo are interested in a pair of gem-decorated boots offered at an art contest which they enter.

videos.title: The Blossom Band
videos.overview: Four odd flower bulbs evolve into walking creatures, and develop an interest in music.

videos.title: Mo and Bo Hit the Road
videos.overview: Mo and Bo want to see a pair of giant tap shoes at a park, but they must do so before dark when the display closes.

videos.title: Happy Fuzzly Birthday
videos.overview: The Fuzzlies have different gift ideas for Abby's birthday which causes some trouble.

videos.title: Bozzly and the Baby
videos.overview: Allen and Jeffrey brought to the hotel their toddler niece Laura who likes playing with Bozzly's ears even though Bozzly does not enjoy it.

videos.title: Fuzzly Lemonade Stand
videos.overview: When the hotel runs out of lemon's for Melvin's stand, Abby's grows giant ones in their garden.

videos.title: A Very Fuzzly Christmas
videos.overview: When guests are unable to come to the Christmas party at the hotel due to an approaching blizzard, Abby and the Fuzzlies decide to deliver gifts instead.

videos.title: Teeny Terry Takes Off
videos.overview: Because birds often fly away immediately whenever he watches them, Teeny Terry turns his bedroom into a rocket.

videos.title: Grumbles, the Squeaky Peeper
videos.overview: Big Doh loses his voice, thus Grumbles fills in to sing with the Squeaky Peepers in Judge Thorn's TV show.

videos.title: Mo and Bo, Where They'd Go
videos.overview: While walking with Abby and Bozzly downtown, Mo and Bo get separated and meet a girl named Sophie.

videos.title: Abby and the Winning Fuzzlies
videos.overview: Mo and Bo win a hotel raffle to get special service, but their desires become too much that the Fuzzlies serving them grow irritated.

videos.title: Mo & Bo Go Toe To Toe
videos.overview: Mo wants to play follow-the-leader, but Bo wants to do rollerskating. Thus they separate and take other playmates.

videos.title: Abby & The Rooftop Playground
videos.overview: Teeny Terry and Princess Flug want to have different playground things on top of Abby's hotel.

videos.title: Blossom Band On Tour
videos.overview: Abby takes the Blossom Band to play in a number of places in the city, but she keeps messing up the shows.

videos.title: Abby's Old Toys
videos.overview: Abby must find a way to play with her little kid toys, or her mother will put them up for donation.

videos.title: Blossom Band & The Rock & Rolling Stage
videos.overview: The Flower Fuzzlies try to win the hotel flower contest.

videos.title: Squeaky Peepers Prize
videos.overview: Little Do gets lost at the carnival and mistaken for a toy.

videos.title: Bozzly & The Missing Pillbug
videos.overview: Bozzly loses his pillbug toy and Abby is determined to find it, unaware it was found by Mrs. Melvin.

videos.title: Grumbles Family Reunion
videos.overview: Abby wants to surprise Grumbles with a visit from his family.

videos.title: Blossom Band Break Up
videos.overview: The Flower Fuzzlies get into a fight and split up.

videos.title: Abby's Quick Fix
videos.overview: The Squeaky Peepers get trapped in the fuzzly passageways during a flood.

videos.title: Abby Farm Animal Friend
videos.overview: Abby visits farmer Jo's farm.

videos.title: The Princess Flug Bug
videos.overview: Princess Flug pretends to be sick.
